messages.subject: Project Zephyr — mutual NDA for signature
messages.plaintextBody:
Sandra,

Good to speak. Attached is the mutual NDA for Project Zephyr, on fairly standard terms — 12-month disclosure window, 3-year survival, mutual, English law. Once this is signed we can start sharing the technical materials and a draft term sheet.

Let me know if you have any comments; otherwise please arrange signature your side and we'll counter-sign.

Best,
James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Corporate & Technology
Whitfield Carter LLP

T +44 (0)20 7946 0519
